newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan tyre output in Feb seen up 0.4% yr/yr - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan tyre output in Feb seen up 0.4% yr/yr - MITI.

text.p: Japan's seven leading tyre makers are expected to produce 88,798 tonnes of tyres in February, up 0.4 percent from the same month a year earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Thursday.

Tyre production in January was estimated at 84,267 tonnes, up 5.2 percent from the same month a year earlier, MITI said. Domestic shipments of tyres are expected to be 49,793 tonnes in February, up 7.7 percent from the same month a year earlier, it said.
